Architectural Designer I
0–3 Years of Experience
Catalpa Architects - 620 N College Ave, Ste 202, Fayetteville, AR 72701
About Us
Catalpa Architects is a small, design-oriented architecture firm in Fayetteville, Arkansas specializing in custom residential and light commercial projects. Our studio values thoughtful design, creative exploration, attention to detail, and a collaborative approach to architecture.
As a small practice, we offer the opportunity to be involved in a broad range of project phases and responsibilities, from initial design concepts through project documentation. We practice a hands-on, collaborative design process where ideas are developed through drawing, modeling, research, and dialogue.
The Position
We are seeking a talented and motivated Architectural Designer with 0–3 years of professional experience to join our studio.
The ideal candidate will have a strong design sensibility, excellent graphic and visualization skills, and an interest in exploring architectural ideas through both digital and physical media. We are looking for someone who is creative, detail-oriented, collaborative, and comfortable contributing to multiple aspects of the design process.
Responsibilities
Collaborate with the design team on conceptual design, schematic design, design development, and project documentation.
Develop and maintain detailed digital building models using BIM software.
Produce architectural drawings, diagrams, and presentation materials.
Create compelling architectural visualizations, renderings, and graphics to communicate design ideas.
Explore design concepts through hand sketching, digital modeling, and physical model making.
Conduct project-related research, including materials, products, building systems, and design precedents.
Assist in the preparation and coordination of architectural drawing sets.
Participate in design discussions, project reviews, and collaborative problem-solving.
Contribute to a studio environment that values design excellence, curiosity, craftsmanship, and attention to detail.
Qualifications
Minimum Requirements
Professional Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch) or Master of Architecture (M.Arch) degree from an accredited university.
0–3 years of professional experience in an architecture firm.
Strong conceptual thinking, design sensibility, and graphic communication skills
Proficiency in BIM software, including Archicad and/or Revit.
Experience with 3D modeling and visualization tools, including Rhino and Twinmotion.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
Preferred Requirements
Strong attention to detail, organization, and commitment to producing high-quality work.
Ability to engage thoughtfully in a collaborative studio environment
Self-motivated, curious, adaptable, and eager to learn.
Ability to balance creative exploration with the technical and practical requirements of architectural projects.
Compensation
Compensation for this role is based on experience, qualifications, and education. The salary range for this position is $45,000 - $60,000, depending on experience. (The salary offered will be based on the length and relevance of the candidate's work history and the skills developed through their professional experiences.)
How to Apply
Qualified candidates should submit a single PDF (10mb max) with a cover letter, resume, references, and work samples via email to [email protected]. You may also include a link to an online portfolio if applicable. In the subject line, include: “Architect/Designer_[FirstName_LastName].” We do not accept in-person walk-ins for job applications or inquiries. All candidates must apply through our official online application process.
